method: Three independent CLI seed processes, each owning a distinct Thread namespace and Actor namespace. Each process serializes the original per-turn seed RPCs and checks native alarm quiescence.
measurementIsolation: The 250-turn workloads finished before these processes started. No measured application turn runs while these seed processes remain active. Read-only collection of historical telemetry may overlap seeding.
timestamps: Exact start/end times and acknowledgements are retained in each fixture's batch receipts.
